facility.name: Tree House Christian Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 6035 FM 78, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78244

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information gathered during the course of the investigation, a caregiver was viewed on the video leaving children alone three times, within a one-and-a-half-minute window.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: Based on the information gathered during the course of the investigation, a caregiver was viewed on the cameras walking away from the changing table more than one time, leaving the child on the changing table for a minimum of 37 seconds the first time and then 6 seconds the second time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the director failed to ensure compliance with the minimum standards when acting as a classroom caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: During the course of the investigation, a caregiver was observed on video clapping and stomping her feet aggressively to redirect the children. The caregiver was also observed getting close to a child?s face in an aggressive manner to redirect them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Based on the information gathered during the course of the investigation, when reviewing the video, a caregiver was on her personal cell phone for over two minutes and on the computer with her back to the children for at least 30 seconds. The caregiver was the only caregiver in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Based on the information gathered during the course of the investigation, it was determined that the child did not wash their hands after getting their diaper changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Based on the information gathered during the course of the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver did not wash her hands after changing a child?s diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Designating Director: The proposed center director has not submitted all of the required trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Designating Director (26 TAC §746.201(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: While a Preschool class was transitioning from the restroom back to the classroom, the teacher failed to account the number of children in her care, resulted in a child being left behind unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: A caregiver was observed failing to utilize the four step process between children while diaper changing.  This was corrected at inspection when the director explained the full process must be followed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Lighting during naptime was observed not adequate.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the lights of the hallway were turned on creating sufficient lighting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Three bottles and one sippy cup in the infant room were not labeled with the child's name.    This was corrected at inspection when the infant caregiver labeled the bottles and cup.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child enrolled with diagnosed food allergies did not have a food allergy emergency action plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Of the five infants required to have an infant feeding schedule, ( not ready for table food) only two infants feeding schedules were available/provided for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: The infant caregiver was observed on their cell phone and wearing a headset while caring for infants as they napped.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During a follow up inspection.  The infant room was observed with only one caregiver supervising seven infants aged five to twelve months.    NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection when another caregiver returned from her lunch break.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four of eight children's files did not have up-to-date immunization records.   Four of eight children's files did not include a signed physician's statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Two caregivers did not have current First Aid certifications.  A third caregiver did not have a current CPR or First Aid certification in her personnel file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One of eight children's files did not have an address listed for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The Director failed to utilize tools provided by Child Care Regulation for observing staff monthly, resulting in non-compliance at the time of review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was conducted on 7/20/23.  A fire inspection has not been conducted since. The fire inspection is overdue.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There was no fire drill documented as conducted in months of April and May/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Two of six caregivers were not current with their First Aid certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the eight files reviewed did not have a current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Toddlers (5) sitting around a table with built in seats, four children were not fastened in with the safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not wash a toddlers hands after changing their diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver gave the incorrect number of children in her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads: Two play yards had infants (12 and 13 months old) sleeping in them with a nap mat with the pillow and blanket attached.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: Three of four infants in the infant area were wearing pacifier leash/holders.    NOTE:  This was corrected as the caregiver took each off of the infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was observed in the restroom alone.  The restroom is located right next to an exit door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection has not been conducted and expired as of 5/9/2023.  There is an inspection scheduled on 7/27/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During a DFPS investigation, a caregiver was heard threatening a child of being spanked when they get home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink: The infant room did not have hand washing sink in the classroom.  There is a portable sink in the classroom but is not set up for use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: Three of the five classrooms at the operation did not have a daily activity schedule available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant room was left with 6 infants to one caregiver during lunch time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of four children did not have updated immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Three of nine employee files did not have an employee affidavit.    One of nine staff did not have verification of their annual training hours in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three of nine staff did not have a current CPR card on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: An infant had her diaper changed and caregiver did not wash her hands.    This was corrected when the caregiver took the child to the restroom to wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During an investigation, it has been determined that the use of cell phones while supervising children; which takes their attention from the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: Operation did not have current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Operation did not have employee records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Four of five children's records did not have addresses listed for any emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of five children's records did not have health statements included in their files.    Two of five files did not have current immunization records in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: During inspection, it was observed the operation do not keep record of monthly safety drills and/or smoke detector/carbon monoxide drills.      The operation does not keep a long of maintenance checks for grounds, facility, or playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Operation did not have current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation cook, has not had a background check submitted, Has been employed since October.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Reviewing the immunizations records one child was missing two of the required shots for their age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: The toddler classroom did not have current written activity plan posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check: Operation allowed staff member to present with children without submitting an initial background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check (26 TAC §745.621(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Floors in the boys and girls restroom  had been cleaned.  Floors had stains and two out of five toilets and urinals had be been flushed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Caregiver was observed sleeping while children were in care. Another staff member had to wake the caregiver up to properly supervise the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Caregivers allowed Children between ages of 12- 23 months to watch tv. The children watched TV for about one hour before caregiver turn it off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
